caption:
There is a specific, demanding rhythm to mountain biking in Costa Rica, where clay, damp volcanic soil, and sudden canopy cover dictate your line. I design every route we ride to balance these physical transitions—testing the climbs myself so that the effort always matches the reward. Understanding this terrain is the difference between a grueling day and a perfect flow through the green. Worth sharing with someone who needs to ride these trails.
